propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces tier wall-clock (306 ms per test via rebar_repo function scope); root cause is repeated git init and config spawning across 589 test functions.
Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and copied per test reduces init overhead from 306 ms to 22.3 ms (13.7x speedup) via shutil.copytree.

Linked worktree pointers in copies must be rewritten (.tickets-tracker/.git and .git/worktrees/-tickets-tracker/gitdir) or git worktree list names the template store, causing shared snapshot cache keys and ref mutation leaks across tests.
Bare git worktree repair silently leaves copies pointing to the template store and corrupts the store if run in-copy; it is not a valid fix-up strategy.

Template fixture must build inside isolated MonkeyPatch context (pinned REBAR_ROOT, empty XDG_CONFIG_HOME, deleted tracker env vars) to prevent first-requester environment contamination from baking into the session template.

Per-test copies must unconditionally re-randomize .env-id and .signing-key (not via init._gen_local_files guard); must reset ensures._pending_cache; must set REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR to prevent snapshot store SHA collision and LRU eviction across workers.
